name: stb
description: Single-file public domain libraries for C and C++, including stb_image.
summary: stb forbids all use of generative AI and LLMs in its submissions: no AI-generated code or documentation, no AI auto completion, and no code or bug reports that were reviewed or analyzed by AI. Pull requests and issues must be written by the contributor personally, in English, even if their English is poor.
